scenes.text: A good questionnaire uses neutral, precise and single-purpose questions with suitable answer options.

Classify this survey question: “Which fruit do you like best?” The answer is clear and neutral. Which fruit do you like best? is classified as clear and neutral; surveys work best with precise neutral wording.
A student at a school fair asks “Do you agree that football is the only fun sport?” in a survey. What describes this question? Pause to choose and explain.
